title: Choose the visual world — Listening to Your Voice
question: The roll assigned Platform Speaker. Keep it, take a challenger, or re-roll.

options.label: Platform Speaker
options.lineage: TEDx / education conference programme visual language
options.thesis: Annette is the idea. The site presents her like a conference programme card for a headliner — authority at scale, one proposition per viewport, the visitor's next step always visible.
materials: confident white space — density varies deliberately
options.viewport: Left: headline at display scale (~4rem), one supporting sentence, orange CTA. Right: Annette's portrait commanding two-thirds of the viewport height. Below the fold: full-width purple band — three credential stats in large white type. Service routing cards follow as two full-width editorial panels with high contrast.
options.risk: Becomes hagiography if the headline names her rather than what the visitor gains in the first 90 days.

options.label: Layered Field
options.lineage: Fly-posted festival hoarding — floating white panel over rich full-bleed art
options.thesis: Full-bleed portrait as the visual ground. One white panel floats on it carrying the headline, CTA, and only the words that earn their keep. Everything else becomes atmosphere.
options.case: Floating-panel-over-photography creates strong immediate impact and uses the existing portrait assets well. Loses on audience identification — the layered/anarchic energy reads as youth marketing rather than senior professional authority.

options.label: Ruled Panels
options.lineage: Azulejo station hall — grid of narrative panels, cobalt on white, seam lines running through every scene
options.thesis: The coaching journey as an ordered sequence of ruled panels. Purple ruling lines replace cobalt. Each section is a framed narrative moment; the grid's seams never hide.
options.case: Grid discipline and ordered narrative panels translate cleanly to a coaching programme's structured arc. Loses on audience identification — the Portugese tile hall isn't in the UK education leader's visual vocabulary; without the distinctive cobalt-on-white material, the grid becomes generic editorial.

options.label: Quiet Spectrum
options.lineage: Iridescent cloud edge — plain white ground with a narrow spectral fringe at transitions
options.thesis: White ground, thin humanist type, section transitions marked by a hairline band of prismatic tints (mint, rose, violet) rather than by background washes or ruled borders.
options.case: Fuses poorly because the iridescent cloud's defining character is scientific specificity — the spectral palette becomes arbitrary pastels without the atmospheric phenomenon to justify them. Loses on product clarity.

canonCard.label: The coaching welcome
canonCard.thesis: What coaching sites reliably ship — warmth, trust signal, single clear call to book.
canonCard.viewport: Off-white ground, portrait in a circle or soft-shadow card, headline in a friendly serif, testimonial, Book a Call button centre-stage.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other wellbeing coach at the scroll distance that decides whether a visitor stays.
